title: fix(spec)!: an aggregation entry refuses an undeclared key by name on every door, REST matching MCP (#28609)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBiH7mWuVM4qYrH5Ba3EJPE)_

Fixes #28609

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skills (`skills/objectstack-query`, `skills/objectstack-api`) and the docs teach only the declared entry members (`function`, `field`, `alias`, `filter`) and never an extra entry key, so nothing they teach changes; the refusal itself names the key and the spelling to send.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 查询里的聚合条目(`aggregations[]` 的每一项)现在在 spec 源头就关闭:写了 spec 没声明的键(比如拼错的 `bogusKey`,或把条目自己的 `filter` 写成 `where`)会被点名拒绝。REST、运行时分发器和 MCP 的 `aggregate_records` 读同一个 schema,拒绝文字一字不差。
- **为什么改:** 上一张卡(#28550)让 MCP 先拒绝了这种键,而 REST 仍然悄悄丢掉它照常返回 200,同一个条目在两个入口得到两种结论。
- **风险与回滚:** 发过多余条目键的调用方(REST、分发器、进程内)会从 200 变成 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`;只含声明键的查询不变。回滚即还原 `query.zod.ts` 一处和 MCP 一处。
- **先看:** `packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts`(`AggregationNodeSchema` 变成 `strictObject`)、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`(删掉 MCP 自己那份条目副本,直接用 spec 节点)、`packages/rest/src/aggregation-entry-undeclared-key-door.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/aggregation-entry-undeclared-key-door.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿(3 个拒绝、2 个对照)。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`AggregationNodeSchema` is closed at the producer** (`packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts`). It is now a `strictObject` with the unknown-key campaign's message (`Unrecognized key(s) on this aggregation entry: KEY.`), near-miss hints `where` / `filters` / `conditions` → `filter` and `as` → `alias`, and a history sentence. The retired `distinct` keeps its `retiredKey()` tombstone and answers that sentence, never the generic refusal (strictObject keeps tombstones out of suggestions). Every door that parses the node inherits it: `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` on `RestServer` and on the runtime dispatcher (both parse `FindDataRequestSchema`), and `EngineAggregateOptionsSchema.aggregations`.
- **MCP folds into it** (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`). `aggregate_records` took each entry as its own `strictToolInput` copy of the node's four members (#28550), a second closed key list. It now takes `AggregationNodeSchema` whole, so the refusal is the spec node's own sentence, the same one REST prints, and `distinct` answers its tombstone on both doors (MCP used to give it the generic unknown-key refusal). `filter` still reaches the bridge unchanged. `tools/list` now lists `distinct` as a schema nothing satisfies (`not: {}`) with its `[REMOVED]` text, and the member descriptions are the spec's.
- **Strictness ledger**: `data/` strip count 64 → 63 (regenerated), and the hand prose rows for `query.zod.ts` re-read and updated to say the node is strict.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28609-aggregation-entry-strict.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/mcp` patch, `fix(spec)!:`, **BREAKING** banner, both declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (a query aggregation entry is a request surface, never stored metadata). It carries one sentence superseding the pending #28550 changeset's "the REST query door is untouched".

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/aggregation-entry-undeclared-key-door.test.ts` (new): the real door (`RestServer` → `findData` → `ObjectQL.aggregate` → sqlite `SqlDriver`). `bogusKey`, entry `where`, entry `as`: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `fields[]` at `query.aggregations.1` carrying exactly `AggregationNodeSchema.safeParse(entry)`'s message, driver never read. Controls: `distinct` keeps its tombstone; declared-only entries (count, sum, filtered count) answer the same grouped numbers.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/data-write-request-gate.test.ts`: one row in `QUERY_REFUSED`, so both doors (RestServer and the dispatcher catch-all) refuse it and the cross-door parity block asserts they answer alike.
- `packages/rest/src/request-schema-gate.conformance.test.ts`: one more violating body on the `/query` route.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.aggregation-entry.test.ts`: refusals now contain the spec node's message; `distinct` gives the tombstone sentence and no "Unrecognized key"; `tools/list` pin updated (`distinct` present, `not: {}`).
- `packages/spec/src/data/query.test.ts`: new block for the closed node (slip, four hints, tombstone not suggested, closure through `QuerySchema` and `EngineAggregateOptionsSchema`, declared-only control); two stale comments that said the node is non-strict corrected.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise held.** Measured on base `0b6a52e8` through the REST door: all three entry slips answered 200 with the grouped numbers.
- **Metadata-protocol measured `none`, not the order's expected `narrowed`.** AGENTS.md defines the line as the change to what a metadata author can write. `check:authorable-surface` stayed green (the node's key list is unchanged; strictness is not on that surface), the spec's own docblock calls QueryAST a request surface never stored in metadata, and the claim recorded `none` as expected. So the changeset is `patch` with the BREAKING banner, the shape AGENTS.md prescribes for a non-protocol breaking change.
- **Analytics re-judged:** `service-analytics` builds its aggregations in the `method` dialect for `IDataEngine` and never imports or parses `AggregationNodeSchema`, so nothing there moves. No open PR touched `query.zod.ts` or the MCP data tools at branch time or before this PR.
- **`dropped-refinements.baseline.json` did not move** (the order's census hypothesis): strictness is not a refinement; `data/AggregationNode` still records only `filter.lazy`.
- **Fixture sweep:** every aggregation-entry literal in the tree (code, tests, skills, docs) was scanned for keys outside the five declared; the only hits are deliberate (`func` pins in driver tests that call drivers directly, `fn` in a plugin-security AST test, the analytics `method` dialect), none of which goes through this schema.

## Verification

All readings at head `09f089de` unless named (the merge of `origin/main` plus the ledger regeneration; nothing of this card moved after the suites below).

<details><summary>Red first, on base 0b6a52e8</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/aggregation-entry-undeclared-key-door.test.ts` with the spec unchanged: 3 failed / 2 passed. `bogusKey`, entry `where` and entry `as` each answered 200 (`expected undefined to be 400`, the handler wrote the grouped rows with no status); the `distinct` tombstone and the declared-only control passed. With the fix: 5/5.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not a kept test)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned the node back into a plain `z.object(shape)` (anchor hit 1/1), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `ablation-dist-preflight spec ablationShape` found the marker in 2 built files. Reds: REST door 3 + REST gate table 1, runtime two-door rows 2, MCP entry file 3, spec block 4 (13 in all); every control stayed green. Restore leg: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean over 588 built files.
</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and dogfood</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec`: 869 files, 24570 passed (before the last spec-test commit; that file then 96/96 on its own).
- `@objectstack/rest`: 364 files, 6915 passed, 332 skipped.
- `@objectstack/runtime` (after building `@objectstack/runtime...`): 504 files, 8189 passed, 19 skipped.
- `@objectstack/mcp`: 48 files, 612 passed.
- Full dogfood (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock after building `@objectstack/dogfood^...`: VERDICT command-exit 0, 369 passed / 3 skipped files, 2981 passed / 28 skipped tests.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on the final head: 85 derived families accounted for, all with exit codes, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0. Two needed a second run: `check:doc-authoring` first red on an issue id in the node's customer-facing `history` sentence (removed, then green), and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 until its fixture commit was fetched (then green). Also green on the final head: `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface` (public API surface unchanged), `check:docs`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`. Repo-wide lint and the `test:repo` project are CI's.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer summary block is the lane's required Chinese section).
